title: Minimum Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram II
description: You are given two lowercase strings `s` and `t`. In one step, you can append any lowercase letter to either `s` or `t`. Return the minimum number of steps required to make `s` and `t` anagrams of each other.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Since you can only append characters, each letter's final count must be at least max(count_s[c], count_t[c]).
The total number of appends equals the sum of |count_s[c] - count_t[c]| over all 26 letters.

examples.explanation: Append "co" and "ts" appropriately: total frequency mismatch across all letters is 7.
Both strings are already anagrams, so 0 appends are needed.
"abc" and "def" share no letters, requiring 6 appends total.
